# Nisc Cloud

> We help businesses of every size get online, stay online, and grow with clear hosting and marketing under one team.

Nisc Cloud provides hosting and digital marketing for businesses of every size. Our four-step Atom Approach covers the full path online: Create, Host, Market, and Automate with Zeepo AI.

## Atom Approach

1. **Create** Brand identity, logo design, website design and development, e-commerce stores, creative assets, and brand copywriting.
2. **Host** Cloud hosting, domain registration (.co.ke, .com, .africa), business email (@yourdomain), SSL certificates, CDN, DDoS protection, 99.99% uptime target, free migration, and setup help.
3. **Market** SEO / AEO / GEO (Google, AI search, Maps), Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, social media management, email marketing, and lead generation.
4. **Automate with Zeepo AI** AI-powered content creation, automated marketing campaigns, CRM workflows, chatbot flows, lead nurturing sequences, and AI email campaigns.

## Why Work With Us

- One team for hosting and marketing
- Clear plans and simple billing
- 100+ businesses growing with us
- 99.99% uptime target
- 24/7 support
- Results in 30 days or we keep working
- Free migration and setup help
